title: I built an AI-powered game engine for the new creators. Would like people to try it out! (this is not a straightforward self/commercial promotion bcz i just want feedback and a few people who would be really willing to try it)
author: oneboy24
selftext:
Viking Engine is an AI-powered game engine for the new creators.

Talk seamlessly with the in-editor AI that assists you while you make your game. Built with a focus on having a visually simplistic editor, it is not meant to overwhelm the new phase of creators with unnecessary engine clutter.

As a fork of Godot Engine, you will be able to work on an already existing game engine which is loved by hundreds of thousands of developers around the world. 

Public alpha out now! (limited time only)

Download it at vikingengine.com.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Are you going to maintain upstream compatibility with godot?

replies.author: oneboy24
replies.body: The current version is based on Godot 4.5. The focus is now on stability and initial feedbacks, and yes, **we are going to maintain upstream compatibility with Godot over time**, even though it will be done carefully instead of rushing updates into the release build.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Can you share the github link?

replies.author: oneboy24
replies.body: It is currently closed-source. But we are open to publishing parts of it later. What things you didn't liked about the engine? I will try to answer my best.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
I'm just wondering what makes you different that all of the other AI focused godot forks out there like https://www.summerengine.com/?

Also, it would be nice to have a mac version available.

replies.author: oneboy24
replies.body:
Fair question.

We will probably not say "Viking Engine is very different than Summer", which will sound too defensive. Summer has done a good job at getting the "AI game engine" concept out in the market so far, really early. But they also might face a tough competition from the big players if they keep progressing exactly like them(if talking only the AI features specifically)

Viking Engine also has the same big idea like Summer Engine. This version is a really scoped one with just a chatbot inside the engine, just enough to show the main idea(ofc agentic AI is where we are eventually headed), but the engine is also for the new phase of creators. People who wants to make a game but don't know how to code or navigating engine UI for first time. 

This also means that we have modified the engine UI/UX to keep only the necessary things visually presentable as well as removed unnecessary engine clutter. Most importantly, the chatbot is not situated at the left/right side of the screen just like all the other AI dev tools like Cursor or whatever because duh it is a whole game engine rather than just a code editor, where it is placed in a new dock which is shown at the center, thereby leaving the other necessary engine docks where they always are.

comments.author: Binoui
comments.body: What can this do than a simple Godot + mcp setup wouldn't?

replies.author: oneboy24
replies.body:
To quite an experienced dev, not at all(i dont recommend it for them)

But to a complete beginner who is starting out, they should not be overwhelmed when making their game for the first time and it's definitely not a requirement that there HAS be MCP setup at this stage.
